text: Binance Dual Investment what is Binance Dual Investment? Binance Dual Investment lets you deposit a cryptocurrency such as BTC and earn yield based on two assets such as BTC or busd. How to subscribe to Binance Dual Investment Log into your Binance account and navigate to Finance Binance Earn Select High Yield, then click on Dual Investment. Each product has a different strike price, delivery date and apy. There are two types of dual investment products up and exercised and down and exercised. Your return will be denominated in the deposit currency or alternate currency depending on the products you chose. How is my return calculated? Imagine that Bob invested 1 BTC on Binance Dual Investment with an up and exercised position. The BTC price was $30,000 and he subscribed to a 30 day product with a 40% annual yield. The strike price was set to $40,000. When the product expires 30 days later, Bob will get one of two outcomes. Scenario 1 BTC is above $40,000. Bob gets the value of his 1 BTC back in BUSD plus the interest. Total 41,315 BUSD. Scenario 2 BTC is below $40,000. The product is not exercised. Bob gets his 1 BTC back plus the 40% annual yield. Total 1.03288 BTC. Alice invested 100 BUSD on Binance Dual Investment with a down and exercised position. The BTC price was $30,000 and she subscribed to a 30 day product with a 40% annual yield. The strike price was set to $20,000. When the product expires 30 days later, Alice will get one of the two outcomes. Scenario 1 BTC is above $20,000. The product is not exercised. Alice gets her 100 BUSD back plus the 40% annual yield. Total 104 BUSD. Scenario 2 BTC is below $20,000. Alice gets the value of her 100 BUSD back in BTC plus the 40% annual yield. TOTAL 0.0052 BTC Binance Dual Investment is a structured product with high risk and high return. The final settlement will be influenced by the settlement price and strike price when the product expires. The respective crypto will be added to your fiat and spot wallet within 48 hours. Note that the dual investment cannot be canceled nor redeemed early once it is subscribed. Dual Investment allows users to obtain profits while satisfying their risk management needs.
